title: Collection of Club Late-Cancellation Charges When Groom Club Monthly Ends
content:
When a Groom Club Monthly membership at the Tailwise Grooming Salon is cancelled, the club late-cancellation charges booked on the club are collected in a share set by the number of charge entries.

**Rule.** The share of the club late-cancellation charges collected in the settlement follows how many such charge entries the club carries: exactly one entry collects 0.5 of the charges booked, exactly two collect 0.75 of them, and none or three or more collect them in full.

| Club late-cancellation charge entries on the club | Share of the charges booked that is collected |
|---|---|
| exactly one | 0.5 |
| exactly two | 0.75 |
| none, or three or more | in full |

The charges booked are the total of the amounts on the club's late-cancellation charge entries; the collected share is added to the settlement as it stands after the early termination fee.

**Worked figures (hypothetical club histories)**

| Charge entries and amounts | Charges booked | Collected |
|---|---|---|
| one entry of 43.99 | 43.99 | 21.995, before the final rounding |
| two entries of 21.99 and 65.99 | 87.98 | 65.985, before the final rounding |
| three entries of 20.00 each | 60.00 | 60.00 |
